description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for internal configuration management within the Fineract platform, specifically for testing purposes. It includes methods for updating global configuration properties and logs warnings indicating it should not be used in production.

classes.name: InternalConfigurationsApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class for managing internal configuration settings, primarily for testing purposes, with methods to update configuration properties and log warnings.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization method that logs warnings indicating the internal config service is enabled and should not be used in production.

methods.name: updateGlobalConfiguration
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update a global configuration property by name, logs the operation, updates the property, clears cache, and reinitializes rounding mode if applicable.
